tasks.label: Check API health and run records
Verify API + frontend validation
tasks.command: cmd /c "curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health & echo. & curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/runs & echo. & cd /d c:\Users\lahar\OneDrive\Desktop\timefault-celesto\frontend & npm run validate"

tasks.label: Check local API endpoints
tasks.command: Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8000/health | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/runs | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5

tasks.label: Probe TimeFault API and Vite
tasks.command: try { $h = Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8001/health -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Output ('HEALTH ' + ($h | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)); $r = Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/runs -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Output ('RUNS ' + ($r | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 8)) } catch { Write-Output ('API_ERROR ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; foreach ($port in 5173,4173) { try { $page = Invoke-WebRequest ('http://127.0.0.1:' + $port) -TimeoutSec 3 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output ('VITE ' + $port + ' ' + $page.StatusCode) } catch { Write-Output ('VITE ' + $port + ' unavailable') } }

tasks.label: Check API CORS headers
tasks.command: try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:8001/health -Headers @{ Origin = 'http://127.0.0.1:5173' } -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output ('STATUS ' + $response.StatusCode); Write-Output ('ALLOW_ORIGIN ' + $response.Headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin']) } catch { Write-Output ('CORS_PROBE_ERROR ' + $_.Exception.Message) }; try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/runs -Method Options -Headers @{ Origin = 'http://127.0.0.1:5173'; 'Access-Control-Request-Method' = 'POST'; 'Access-Control-Request-Headers' = 'content-type' } -TimeoutSec 5 -UseBasicParsing; Write-Output ('OPTIONS ' + $response.StatusCode); Write-Output ('OPTIONS_ALLOW_ORIGIN ' + $response.Headers['Access-Control-Allow-Origin']) } catch { Write-Output ('OPTIONS_ERROR ' + $_.Exception.Message) }

tasks.label: Create integration test run via API
tasks.command: $body = @{ scenario_id = 'CF-17' } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; $created = Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/runs -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output ('CREATED ' + ($created | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)); $runs = Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/runs -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output ('LIST_CONFIRMED ' + (($runs.runs | Where-Object { $_.run_id -eq $created.run_id } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)))

tasks.label: Verify frontend proxy
tasks.command: $health = Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:5173/health -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output ('PROXY_HEALTH ' + ($health | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)); $runs = Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:5173/api/runs -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output ('PROXY_RUN_COUNT ' + $runs.count); Write-Output ('PROXY_CF17 ' + (($runs.runs | Where-Object { $_.scenario_id -eq 'CF-17' } | Measure-Object).Count))

tasks.label: Final Python suite with path guard
Compose configuration validation
tasks.command: $env:POSTGRES_PASSWORD='temp-only'; $env:DATABASE_URL='postgresql://timefault:temp-only@db:5432/timefault'; docker compose config --quiet; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Output 'compose config valid'
